description: 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소_중기 행정구역별 위험단계 결과값 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. 본 자료는 기후에너지 환경부 한강홍수통제소의 AI 홍수예보시스템에서 중기 침수위험 예측을 기반으로 시. 군. 구 행정구역별 강우와 침수 위험을 분석하여 위험단계(관심,주의,경계,심각). Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기후에너지환경부 한강홍수통제소. Its tags are AI 홍수예보시스템, 중기 침수위험 예측, 시군구 행정구역별 강우, 시군구 행정구역별 침수 위험, 관심. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
